title: The Detroit River meets Lake Erie
caption: NOAA aerial image showing the Detroit River’s southern entrance and northeastern Lake Erie. Geographic context for the waterway, not a photograph of early settlement.

title: Ford Piquette Avenue Plant
caption: The surviving plant’s front exterior. This is the building where the first Model Ts were produced, not a view of assembly-line work.

title: Second Baptist Church of Detroit
caption: The church exterior, photographed in July 2008. A surviving institution for a reading about the support networks that make arrival possible.

title: Rivera Court — industry on the walls
caption: A 2025 interior view of Rivera Court at the Detroit Institute of Arts, showing the Detroit Industry murals in their architectural setting. The murals date to 1932–1933.

title: Hitsville U.S.A.
caption: The Hitsville U.S.A. buildings in Detroit, photographed in June 2006. The preserved place anchors the history of Motown and the work of keeping its story.
credit: Blob4000 at English Wikipedia Later versions were uploaded by FuriousFreddy at en.wikipedia.

title: Lafayette Park after redevelopment
caption: A 2006 view of Lafayette Park redevelopment in the former Black Bottom area. This shows a later landscape, not the vanished neighborhood before clearance.

title: Michigan Central Station — a later chapter
caption: Michigan Central Station photographed in July 2026, after its restoration. A contemporary image for the reading about reuse and continuing change.

title: Public space on the riverfront
caption: Rivard Place on Detroit’s riverfront, April 2008, with its promenade and carousel. Context for public waterfront access; this is not the newer Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Centennial Park.
